$comment: Central component inventory and lock set. This file is the single source of truth for
every external component CloudBurrow builds on. Reproducible builds consume the
'verified' versions here; #31 maintains it and tests 'latest-candidate' sets in an
isolated lane. A mutable tag may be used for discovery, never as the release pin:
'digest' is what a reproducible artifact resolves.

mode.verified: The pinned set below. Used by all ordinary, release and offline builds.
mode.latestCandidate: Discovered by #31, tested in isolation, never used for release artifacts until promoted here.

kind.notes: Initial and only reference cluster provider.

kubernetesNodeImage.notes: kind v0.33.0 publishes v1.34.11, v1.35.8, v1.36.4, v1.37.0. Chosen above Knative's enforced minimum without being newest. Digest resolved and pinned by #26/#28.
kubernetesNodeImage.skipDiscovery: Version tracks Kubernetes, not the kind release that publishes it, so the source repository's tags are not comparable. Upgraded together with kind using the node images listed in that release's notes.

constraints.kubernetesMaxVersionNote: Upstream states no maximum. Not assumed.

knativeNetKourier.notes: Networking layer. Must be upgraded together with knativeServing.

pubsubEmulator.distribution: gcloud component 'pubsub-emulator', or the official image below
pubsubEmulator.licenseNote: The Cloud CLI is Apache-2.0 'unless otherwise specified by an alternate license file'. The JAR's LICENSE/NOTICE belong to bundled dependencies; the emulator's own classes have no published source. Do not claim it is open source.
pubsubEmulator.redistributionPlan: Run the official image pinned by digest, or have the user run 'gcloud components install pubsub-emulator'. Do not vendor the binary.
limitations: Does not persist state; a topic was NotFound after restart even with --data-dir.
Signed-URL signatures are not verified; a bogus X-Goog-Signature returned HTTP 200.

go.notes: Minimum language version in go.mod. 1.26 and 1.27 are the supported releases.

sdks.$comment: Official SDKs, used only to prove compatibility. Pinned by go.sum.

goCloudTasks.notes: Generated contract types for the service CloudBurrow implements.

goCloudRun.notes: Generated contract types for the Cloud Run v2 adapter.

goGrpc.notes: Minimum v1.83.2: earlier versions carry GO-2026-6348 and GO-2026-6443, both reachable once a gRPC server is served.

goProtobuf.notes: Stable release; was previously pinned to a pseudo-version.

pythonVertexPrediction.notes: Read only to confirm the AIP_* contract constants and to evaluate LocalModel. CloudBurrow does not depend on it at runtime; deploy_to_local_endpoint is declined by design (docs/prediction.md).
pythonVertexPrediction.skipDiscovery: Published on PyPI, not GitHub releases; depcheck only discovers GitHub-sourced components.

goOAuth2.notes: Promoted from indirect to direct: the credentials compatibility test drives google.FindDefaultCredentials through it. Same version as before; no new dependency was added.

goSecretManager.notes: Generated contract types for the Secret Manager implementation, and the client the compatibility tests drive it with.

goNet.notes: Promoted from indirect to direct for h2c, which lets Secret Manager serve gRPC and JSON on one port. Same version as before; no new dependency was added.

googleapis.notes: No release tags upstream, so an explicit commit is pinned. Generated Go packages are consumed rather than generated locally; see docs/api-contracts.md.

buildpacksBuilder.notes: Published for amd64 only; on arm64 it runs under emulation and produces an amd64 image.

functionsFrameworkGo.notes: Used by the test fixture only; not a CloudBurrow dependency.

predictorFixtureGo.notes: Build stage for the prediction fixture in testdata/predictor. Multi-arch manifest list.
predictorFixtureGo.skipDiscovery: Docker Hub tag list; depcheck only discovers GitHub-sourced components. Re-resolve the digest with `docker buildx imagetools inspect`.

predictorFixtureBase.notes: Runtime base for the prediction fixture. Pinned so the image that proved the contract is the image a later run rebuilds.
predictorFixtureBase.skipDiscovery: GCR tag list; depcheck only discovers GitHub-sourced components. Re-resolve the digest with `docker buildx imagetools inspect`.

litertLM.$comment: Built from source: no LiteRT-LM release publishes a Linux artifact, but Linux is a documented, supported build target.
litertLM.redistribution: built locally; no image is published
litertLM.buildTool: bazel 7.6.1 via bazelisk, pinned by the repo's .bazelversion
litertLM.notes: Debian 13 rather than 12: Abseil needs C++20 <source_location>, absent from bookworm's default clang 14 and present in trixie's default clang 19.1.7. Measured on arm64 CPU: 80.75 tok/s prefill, 31.81 tok/s decode.
litertLM.skipDiscovery: Pinned by commit, not by release tag: releases publish no Linux artifact, so the tag is not what is consumed.

generationModel.$comment: The only model that is both runnable and obtainable without credentials. A COMMUNITY conversion, not Google-published.
generationModel.redistribution: downloaded by the developer; not redistributed
generationModel.skipDiscovery: Hugging Face repository, not a GitHub release.

unresolved: Digests for kindest/node, Knative release YAML and fake-gcs-server are null until #26/#28 resolve and verify them. A null digest means this entry is not yet reproducible.
Knative v1.23.0 + Kubernetes v1.36.4 is pinned but not yet verified end to end; #28 is the gate.
